::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 11th 1895  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 2214-5
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
Of course it will not make much difference to me whether [‘the Long Vacation](cmy_books/cmybook_237.qmd)’ appears in April or September, so it had better be arranged as you have decided.

I should prefer the [Royalty of /4](organizations/other_160.qmd) on the American Copyright to an immediate sum.[^1]

Might I ask, as I have been before encouraged to do, for a copy of Dean Church’s [Life and Letters](other_books/otherbook_706.qmd) and also for [Sonny Sahib](other_books/otherbook_705.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The word 'Colonial' has been substituted in another hand.
